  "attention": "The PDB record 5FBH for the human calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) extracellular domain (ECD). I am focusing on the structural organization of the Venus Flytrap (VFT) domain as described in the literature and the specific metal-binding sites identified in the crystal structure.",
  "factual_observation": "The human CASR is a 1078 amino acid G protein-coupled receptor. Its extracellular domain (ECD) is approximately 600 amino acids long and contains a bi-lobed Venus Flytrap (VFT) domain (PMID: 23856260). The crystal structure of the ECD (PDB: 5FBH) was resolved at 2.7 Å and shows the VFT domain bound with Mg2+ and a tryptophan derivative ligand (PMID: 27386547). The record identifies specific metal sites: MG (Mg2+) at residue 602 (Chain B) is coordinated by SER 240 and a water molecule; MG at residue 603 (Chain B) is coordinated by LEU 88, ILE 81, and LEU 87; and MG at residue 602 (Chain A) is coordinated by ILE 81, LEU 87, LEU 88, and SER 84. The literature notes that the hinge region between the two globular subdomains of the VFT domain plays a pivotal role in coordinating multiple stimuli and cooperative activation (PMID: 27386547, PMID: 27746744).",
